description: Get the article content as markdown. Screenshots appear as <SCREENSHOT {id}> placeholders, and things markdown can't show (an embedded video, a pasted image) as <EMBED {id}> placeholders. Returns the markdown text, a list of screenshot IDs and the article_version to pass to update_article. With include_clips it also returns the project's clips in timeline order (the real route of the video) with each clip's voiceover text and sync points; works before an article exists.

include_clips.description: Also return clips in timeline order: clip_id, title, kind (video | slide), voiceover_text (capped per clip) and sync_points [{label, source_time_s}] (seconds on the clip's own recording: the clock grab_source_frame uses). Write article steps from these, one per action the clips show.

name: get_article
title: Get article
